name: The Design System Guide
summary: Guide and resource hub for setting up a design system: chapters, tools, checklists and courses.
description: A guide and resource hub for building and running a design system, with chapters on documentation, collaboration and metrics, plus a knowledge base, bookmarks, tools, checklists, a podcast and practitioner interviews. Free to read with a newsletter; paid self-paced courses cover design tokens and the Airtable inventory workflow.
